# Leonardo Gotardo

> Software Developer based in Londrina, Brazil. Specializing in embedded systems, REST APIs, IoT, and full-stack web development. Currently working at IrisPay (Brazilian fintech). Pursuing Analysis and Systems Development degree at IFPR.

## About

Leonardo Gotardo is a Software Developer based in Londrina, Paraná, Brazil. He works at IrisPay — a Brazilian fintech converting traditional vending machines into smart payment systems via proprietary hardware — working across the full stack: embedded systems, automation, REST APIs, sockets, cryptography, IoT, and web development.

Simultaneously pursuing a degree in Analysis and Systems Development at IFPR and building open-source side projects covering cryptography, GUI programming, algorithms, and Python libraries published on PyPI.

- Location: Londrina, Paraná, Brazil
- Languages: Portuguese (Native), English (Full Professional)
- Education: Analysis & Systems Development — IFPR

### ipTool (Mar 2026 — Present)
Geographic IP lookup tool with interactive Leaflet map, IPv4/IPv6 validation, and detailed network data.

### Maze Solver (Jun 2025 — Present)
Interactive maze generator and solver implementing DFS and BFS search algorithms with step-by-step visualization.
- Procedural maze generation with configurable dimensions
- DFS and BFS solvers with animated visualization
- Matrix-based representation: 0 = path, 1 = wall
- Live: https://dfsxbfs.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/LeoGotardo/RedBlackTree
- Stack: JavaScript, Algorithms, DFS, BFS, Data Structures

### noHarmBack (2025 — Present)
Backend service for noHarm, a mobile addiction recovery app. Clean Architecture with real-time chat, streak tracking, and AES-256 encrypted user data.
- FastAPI REST API with JWT authentication and token blacklisting
- Real-time messaging via Socket.IO WebSockets
- Streak tracking system with achievement badges
- AES-256 field-level encryption, rate limiting, XSS sanitization
- Alembic migrations with Neon PostgreSQL, deployed on Vercel
- GitHub: https://github.com/LeoGotardo/noHarmBack
- Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, SQLAlchemy, JWT, Vercel

### GeoKnocker (Jun 2024 — Aug 2024)
GUI desktop tool for port scanning and IP geolocation with dark/light theme and concurrent scanning.
- Port scanning via raw Python sockets
- IP geolocation using public REST APIs
- Concurrent scans with threading for performance
- CustomTkinter GUI with dark/light theme toggle and loading animations
- GitHub: https://github.com/LeoGotardo/GeoKnocker
- Stack: Python, Sockets, Threading, Tkinter, CustomTkinter

### Hash Table (Nov 2025 — Dec 2025)
Hash table implementation in C with chaining for collision resolution and automatic rehashing at 75% load factor.
- CPF-keyed records storing name and age
- Separate chaining via linked lists for collision handling
- Auto-rehash: doubles capacity when load factor ≥ 0.75
- Insert, search, delete, and statistical analysis operations
- GitHub: https://github.com/LeoGotardo/hashtable
- Stack: C, Data Structures, Algorithms
